title: OMIR Relationship (R1)
description: A directed, weighted edge between two Entity resources. Strength is dynamic (Hebbian): it increases with co-activation and decays without use. OMM level 3.

relationType.description: Open vocabulary. Common values: works_with, works_at, employed_by, part_of, contains, owned_by, located_in, located_at, related_to. Implementations MAY mint new lowercase snake_case values.

strength.description: Synaptic weight (0..1). Dynamic under Hebbian plasticity. NOTE: producer-private; for portable spreading activation use 'normalizedStrength' + 'normalization'.

reverseStrength.description: EP-6c (D5): backward association weight P(from|to); asymmetric counterpart to 'strength' = P(to|from). Resolves the symmetric-scalar half of D5 without two independent edges. OMM-0.

normalizedStrength.description: EP-6c (D5): fan-normalized strength. Within a source Entity's outgoing edge set sharing one 'normalization' these sum to <= 1+epsilon (ACT-R fan: source activation conserved and divided). THIS is the portable spreading-activation / PPR weight; raw 'strength' is producer-private. MUST co-occur with 'normalization'. OMM-0.

normalization.description: EP-6c (D5): the normalization regime that makes 'normalizedStrength' portable across importers. OMM-0.

validAt.description: When this relationship was last observed to hold (temporal tracking).

invalidatedAt.description: When this relationship was invalidated, if ever (temporal edge invalidation).

sourceEpisode.description: Episode reference that produced this relationship.
